root_idea.summary: The evidence records two related lexical images: النَّأْي is distance or remoteness, while النُّؤْي is a trench that keeps rainwater away from a tent.
root_idea.development: The distance branch extends from spatial remoteness to personal withdrawal and aloofness. The Quranic Form I verb expresses becoming or keeping remote, while the related derived forms preserve the notions of withdrawal, a distant place, and a barrier that keeps something away.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form I verb is presented under the normalized Classical Arabic citation form نَأَى.

senses.definition: To become distant, keep away, withdraw, or turn away.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for personal or relational distancing and withdrawal. This broad distancing sense is distinct from the Quranic construction نَأَى بِجَانِبِهِ, which conveys haughty aloofness.

senses.definition: To turn away and hold oneself aloof, expressing haughtiness or self-exalting arrogance.
senses.usage_conditions: Occurs in the construction نَأَى بِجَانِبِهِ. The construction uses the imagery of withdrawing one's side and is explained as a figurative expression of arrogance.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal/verbal-noun expression for being far or distant, distinct in form from the Quranic finite verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A trench or ditch dug around a tent to keep rainwater away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a protective earthwork surrounding a tent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or construct a نُؤْي around a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV usage associated with making the rain-diverting trench.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw or keep at a distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VIII derivative of نَأَى, cited as expressing the same distancing branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A distant place; also the site or location of the related نُؤْي.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun associated with انتأى; the evidence applies it both to a distant place and, in the نُؤْي terminology, to the place of the trench.

cautions: No Lane primary source units were supplied in the evidence packet; the broader Classical Arabic coverage therefore relies on the supplied Maqāyīs and Mufradāt evidence.
A variant Quranic reading نَاءَ بِجَانِبِهِ is reported for the construction cited at 17:83, but the public form here follows the QAC form نَأَى.
